title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingDevice
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingDevice. Device that processes waste. Subclass of saref:Device (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.4); top of the pre-treatment/treatment/disposal device hierarchy (WastePreTreatmentDevice, WasteTreatmentDevice, WasteDisposalDevice and their own subclasses), whose own models document only their own additional attributes (most have none) and inherit this model's attributes, including location.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProcessingDevice'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the waste processing device, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

directlyConsumes.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/directlyConsumes'. A waste processing device directly consumes one or more primary or secondary raw resources. Links to PrimaryRawResource or SecondaryRawResource entities (open target type).

indirectlyConsumes.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/indirectlyConsumes'. A waste processing device indirectly consumes one or more primary or secondary raw resources. Links to PrimaryRawResource or SecondaryRawResource entities.

directlyEmits.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/directlyEmits'. A waste processing device directly emits one or more emissions. Links to Emission entities.

indirectlyEmits.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/indirectlyEmits'. A waste processing device indirectly emits one or more emissions. Links to Emission entities.

produces.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/produces'. A waste processing device produces one or more secondary raw resources and/or final waste. Links to SecondaryRawResource or FinalWaste entities (open target type).

acceptedWasteKinds.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from 'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/accepts' (ontology restriction: minimum 1), range s4envi:WasteKind. Known individuals: same non-exhaustive list as Container's acceptedWasteKinds.

yield.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Yield'. Ratio of input waste to output resource. Unitless ratio.

usesCommunicationInterface.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationInterface'. A relation between a device and the communication interface it uses. Links to a CommunicationInterface entity.

usesCommunicationProtocol.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationProtocol'. A relation between a device and the communication protocol it uses. Links to a CommunicationProtocol entity.
